speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Please tell me your age and how long you have been experiencing these skin lesions. REQUEST TEST: Blood count and liver function tests.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the normal blood count and liver function results. Can you describe the appearance of these skin lesions, such as their color, shape, and if they are itchy or painful?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-year-old female. The patient's mother reports noticing multiple painless, nonpruritic papules on the child's abdomen. The child attends daycare where another child was reported to have similar lesions recently. Patient's brother had chickenpox one month ago. Immunizations are up-to-date.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Molluscum Contagiosum

The normal blood work and the description of painless, non-itchy papules strongly point away from chickenpox, especially given the child's up-to-date immunizations. The recent exposure to a similar case at daycare supports a contagious viral etiology.
